files.description:
Alien cards, intended to replace the (per alien) handout, two setup cards, and player shield supplied with the game. Does not include the setup for each alien, and only mentions alien abilities that do not otherwise appear on other cards or tokens.

For example, does not mention Faderan Acknowledgements, since the tokens will be sitting in front of the player, nor the Eni Et converter restriction, since it appears on those converters, but does mention that Caylion colony bids are halved.
